name: ICD-10 - everyday codes
description: Frequently used ICD-10 codes and chapter structure. Coding rules vary by country and revision (ICD-10-CM adds extra digits) - check your local code set before billing.

cards.question: ICD-10 code for essential (primary) hypertension?
ICD-10 code for type 2 diabetes mellitus?
cards.answer: E11 (E10 is type 1)

cards.question: ICD-10 code for acute myocardial infarction?
cards.answer: I21 - e.g. I21.9 acute MI, unspecified; I22 is a subsequent MI.

cards.question: ICD-10 code for heart failure?
cards.answer: I50 - I50.9 unspecified, I50.0 congestive (ICD-10-CM splits systolic I50.2 / diastolic I50.3).

cards.question: ICD-10 code for asthma?
cards.answer: J45 (J45.9 asthma, unspecified)

cards.question: ICD-10 code for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease?
cards.answer: J44 - J44.9 COPD unspecified, J44.1 with acute exacerbation.

cards.question: ICD-10 code for pneumonia, unspecified organism?
ICD-10 code for a urinary tract infection, site not specified?
ICD-10 code for gastro-oesophageal reflux disease without oesophagitis?
cards.answer: K21.9 (K21.0 is GORD with oesophagitis)

cards.question: ICD-10 code for cerebral infarction (ischaemic stroke)?
cards.answer: I63 - I61 is intracerebral haemorrhage, I60 subarachnoid haemorrhage.

cards.question: ICD-10 code for chronic kidney disease, stage 5?
cards.answer: N18.5 (N18.6 is end-stage renal disease, N18.9 CKD unspecified)

cards.question: ICD-10 code for a major depressive episode, single, unspecified severity?
cards.answer: F32.9 (F33 is recurrent depressive disorder)

cards.question: ICD-10 code for generalised anxiety disorder?
ICD-10 code for migraine?
cards.answer: G43 - G43.0 without aura, G43.1 with aura, G43.9 unspecified.

cards.question: ICD-10 code for acute appendicitis?
cards.answer: K35 - e.g. K35.80 acute appendicitis, unspecified (ICD-10-CM).

cards.question: ICD-10 code for malignant neoplasm of the breast?
cards.answer: C50, with a fourth character for the site (e.g. C50.9 breast, unspecified).

cards.question: ICD-10 code for hyperlipidaemia, unspecified?
cards.answer: E78.5 (E78.0 pure hypercholesterolaemia, E78.1 pure hyperglyceridaemia)

cards.question: ICD-10 code for COVID-19 with the virus identified?
cards.answer: U07.1 (U07.2 is COVID-19, virus not identified - clinically or epidemiologically diagnosed).

cards.question: Which body system does ICD-10 chapter 'I' cover?
cards.answer: Diseases of the circulatory system (I00-I99).

cards.question: What do ICD-10 codes starting with 'Z' describe?
cards.answer: Factors influencing health status and contact with health services - screening, follow-up, immunisation, family history (Z00-Z99), not diseases.

cards.question: How is a standard ICD-10 code structured?
cards.answer: One letter followed by two digits gives the three-character category (e.g. J45); a decimal point plus further characters add detail (J45.909). ICD-10-CM allows up to seven characters.

cards.question: ICD-10 code for a routine general adult medical examination without abnormal findings?
cards.answer: Z00.00 (ICD-10-CM); Z00.0 in the WHO ICD-10.
